_comment: Sepolia rehearsal manifest for wsnUSDC. The rehearsal runs the production deploy script deliberately, so the code exercised here is the code that broadcasts on mainnet; only the sign-off gate is skipped, by chain id. The salt tag is plain ASCII rather than mined, and it is bumped one rehearsal at a time (T1, T2 and so on) because CREATE3 cannot redeploy at an address it has already used. active false so the rehearsal also covers the dormant deploy and ActivateVault.
